title: Briefing the Institute of Noetic Sciences board

tellings.quote: Like I astronaut Ed Edgar Mitchell invited me to uh brief the board of knowetic sciences back years ago.

plain: In the 1990s, a UFO researcher named Steven Greer says the astronaut Edgar Mitchell invited him to brief the board of the Institute of Noetic Sciences, a research body that studies consciousness, at one of its retreats. Greer tells Michels this as something he did himself, and also names the UFO researcher Jacques Vallée and Senator Claiborne Pell in connection with it. It is told to show that people with real standing took his UFO work seriously enough to hear him out.
